description: “Proposed rear single storey rear extension, basement extension with front and rear lightwells”
decision_conditions: The proposed basement extension and associated lightwells by reason of their substantial size, detailed design, and level of excavation, results in the potential loss of vegetation at the site including a large tree shown within the rear garden and fails to retain sufficient area to facilitate planting, and support local biodiversity by way of replacement, for which no information has been submitted to demonstrate otherwise. As such, the proposed development is contrary to policies G1 (Green infrastructure) and G6 (Biodiversity and access to nature) of the London Plan (2021), policies LP46 (Protection and Enhancement of Green Infrastructure),&nbsp; LP47 (<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: transparent; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; vertical-align: baseline;">Biodiversity and Sites of Importance of Nature Conservation)</span>&nbsp;and LP51 (Tree Management and Landscaping) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020), and the guidance contained within Hackney Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2025).&nbsp;

The proposed basement extension and rear lightwell, by reason of their size, depth and detailed design, results in a disproportionate development that involves the loss of over 50% of the rear garden, extending 7.5m past the existing rear wall of the dwelling to the full width of the property being set against the boundary with both adjoining neighbours. This has a harmful impact on the character and appearance of the host property and the terrace it forms part of and results in a substandard form of accommodation with the further loss of amenity space.&nbsp; As such, the proposed development is contrary to policies D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach) and D4 (Delivering good design) and D6 (Housing quality and standards) of the London Plan (2021), policies LP1 (Design Quality of Local Character) and LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020), and the guidance contained within Hackney Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2025).
